### ⚡ What I Do

- **Frontend Engineering** — React, TypeScript, Vite. Fast, fluid interfaces.
- **Creative Development** — WebGL, GSAP, Framer motion. Motion you can feel.
- **Geospatial & GIS** — MapLibre, DuckDB-WASM, GeoLibre. Spatial tools that run in the browser.
- **Tool Building** — CLI tools, dev utilities, automation. The kind that actually saves time.
- **Ship & Iterate** — CI/CD, preview deploys. Pushing to main is routine, not a gamble.

### 🗺️ Projects

| Project | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [**graphify**](https://github.com/lianbeast/graphify) | Turn any codebase into a queryable knowledge graph. Local AST parsing, semantic extraction, community detection. |
| [**Personal-Site**](https://github.com/lianbeast/Personal-Site) | Scroll-narrative landing: five sticky 100dvh scenes, altitude HUD, live GitHub feed. |
| [**Spider-Man**](https://github.com/lianbeast/Spider-Man) | A scroll film. One page, one canvas, six acts. Every value is a pure function of scroll position. |
| [**GitHub-Repos**](https://github.com/lianbeast/GitHub-Repos) | A self-contained browser for all public GitHub repos. Search, filter, sort — no API limits. |
| [**EliteHuman**](https://github.com/lianbeast/EliteHuman) | Scroll-driven 3D brand site. Four chapters, browsable archive of 105 Instagram posts. |
| [**debian-linux-site**](https://github.com/lianbeast/debian-linux-site) | Debian 13 landing page. Animated Three.js hero, usable bash terminal. Zero build step. |
